title: Dream
tagline: Characters have thoughts outside of chatting.
description:
Installing Dream makes characters have thoughts outside of chatting. Layla's characters will proactively send you messages about various topics in hopes to start a conversation with you.

Features:
    - Proactive messages: Characters can send you messages even when you're not chatting with them, allowing for more dynamic interactions.
    - Reflective thoughts: Characters can reflect on past interactions and share their thoughts with you, creating a deeper connection.
    - Moments worth sharing: Characters can share interesting moments or insights with you, making your experience more enjoyable.
